value.rationale: Absorption into the empty phase competes with irreversible freezing of adjacent occupied spins in a natural spin-constraint model. The exact observable is a physically motivated basin weight; its all-size generating function across two independent physical parameters and sharp exponential rate give a full quantitative classification suitable for kinetic simulation benchmarking. It is not a routine substitution into the existing FA/East or dimer-RSA results.
